## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Tests / QA
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Engineering catalog / scoring / method
- [ ] Data model / migration
- [ ] Release / build infrastructure

## Verification

List the tests, devices/emulators, reports, or manual checks used to verify the change.

## Data and compatibility

- [ ] Existing identifiers remain stable, or an explicit migration is included.
- [ ] Backward compatibility was considered.
- [ ] No real bridge backups, sensitive locations, personal signatures, credentials, or signing keys are included.

## Engineering-method changes

If this changes scoring, defect definitions, thresholds, standards mapping, or safety logic, link the supporting source and update the relevant documentation.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] RTL / large-text / day-night behavior was checked when UI is affected.
- [ ] Security and privacy implications were considered.
